subject: Request: one-off credit + 45-day POC extension for Foster.ai
messages:
From: Kelly Nguyen <kelly@foster.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 6 May 2027 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Request: 45-day extension + additional credits for POC

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Foster.ai is excited about Redwood's latency profile and the model routing options. We hit an unexpected compliance gating in our integration (legal needs an architecture addendum) which pushed our test window out by ~3 weeks.

We are currently at ~65% of the free seats/credits you provided and the team needs an extra 45 days to complete the integration and run the key throughput tests. Our ask: a one-off extension of the POC window by 45 days and an additional 150k complimentary token credit to finish the evaluation.

Attached is a short note from our CTO summarizing the delay and the priority tests (foster_request_0506.pdf). If this requires an executive sign-off, please escalate — we have procurement and legal ready to sign a small SOW once the extension is granted.

Appreciate any flexibility you can offer.

—Kelly
Kelly Nguyen
Head of Platform, Foster.ai
kelly@foster.ai
+1 415-555-0192

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Kelly Nguyen <kelly@foster.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 6 May 2027 12:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: 45-day extension + additional credits for POC

Kelly — thanks for the context and the CTO note.

Quick heads up on our standard PLG terms: free sandbox windows are 30 days with a baseline credit allotment (usually capped around 50k units for the initial trial). I can escalate a one-off exception to Deal Desk + myself for exec approval, but we’ll need a concise mutual action plan and the procurement timeline you mentioned.

Can you confirm:
- The exact conversion metric you expect (tokens vs. credit usage) — I see current usage in the attachment but would like a short line describing the 150k ask in your terms.
- Procurement sign-off ETA (DocuSign or PO?)

I’ve looped in Jordan from Deal Desk to scope the ask; he can propose options (partial credit + extension vs. full credit + milestone). Jordan: recommend we prep a short summary for Aditya and Kimberly by Monday.

I’ll aim to get back with a firm answer no later than Friday EOD.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
Phone: +1 510-555-0146

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 8 May 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Foster.ai — credit + extension request (summary & proposal)

Aditya / Kimberly — forwarding Foster.ai's ask. Quick summary below and proposal to consider:

External ask: 45-day POC extension + 150k complimentary token credits (Foster.ai). They cite legal/architectural gating that delayed the integration ~3 weeks. They indicate procurement is ready to sign a small SOW to secure a paid conversion if the extension is granted.

Current status / signals:
- HubSpot: Deal in POC stage (DEAL-7521), ARR potential $120k ARR annualized if converted.
- Demo feedback: positive on latency & routing; engineering team actively testing.
- Current free usage: ~65% of baseline credits.

Proposal options:
A) Approve 45-day extension + 150k credits (full ask) — high win probability but larger unit cost.
B) Approve 45-day extension + 100k credits + conversion milestone: if they sign SOW within extension, we issue remaining 50k credits.
C) Approve 30-day extension + 100k credits (closer to PLG limits).

Attachments: foster_poc_metrics.xlsx (usage + projected runway), SOW-draft.pdf (procurement-ready small SOW).

Recommendation: Option B — covers customer runway while preserving leverage for conversion. If approved, Marissa will communicate terms and request a signed SOW link.

Please reply with sign-off or edits.

—Jordan
Senior Deal Desk Analyst
jordan.blake@redwood.com

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Foster.ai — credit + extension request (summary & proposal)

Thanks for the concise write-up, Jordan. I reviewed the HubSpot notes and the usage workbook. Foster.ai looks strategic (reasonable ARR upside and good technical fit). I approve Option B with one additional condition:

Approved terms (one-off exception):
- Grant 45-day POC extension starting 2027-05-10.
- Issue 100k credits up-front; place remaining 50k credits in reserve to be issued immediately upon receipt of signed SOW or PO within the 45-day window.
- Require a short MOU attached to the SOW stating expected conversion timeline; if no signed SOW/PO by the end of extension, remaining credits are forfeited and sandbox will be suspended.
- Finance to issue one-time internal credit memo for cost tracking.

Marissa: please send Foster.ai the approved terms and the SOW DocuSign link. Jordan / Kimberly: loop in finance and legal to log the deviation and ensure we capture the conversion milestone in the SOW.

Aditya Rao
VP, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0123
